mentions.name: Jujutsu-based version control forge
mentions.description: A new version control forge built around Jujutsu. It aims to be more opinionated than raw Git, optimized for team usage rather than individual workflows, use nicer algorithms for diffing and merges, and scale better than Git for entire teams of developers, combining existing good ideas into a coherent product.
mentions.problem: GitHub has poor UX, and Git scales poorly for entire teams of developers.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm building a new version control forge around Jujutsu :).
